name: Morris Packaging
old_description: Engineering and Producing Packaging for a Sustainable Tomorrow
about:
Morris Packaging operates from its home office in Bloomington, Illinois, with an additional facility in Lebanon, Kentucky. The company focuses on engineering and producing flexible and multi-wall packaging solutions.

The company manufactures a range of flexible packaging formats including flat-bottom bags, quad-seal bags, stand-up pouches, rollstock, and its proprietary RevoPack line. It also produces multi-wall bags such as pasted-valve, pinch-bottom, sewn-open-mouth, and self-opening-square styles. Beyond production, Morris Packaging offers nationwide warehousing, inventory management, brand design services, and logistics support including pilot programs and short-run capabilities for market testing. Ancillary packaging supplies such as corrugated boxes, stretch wrap, and tape round out the offering.

Morris Packaging serves the pet food, treats, and litter sector, as well as food, chemical and aggregate, and lawn and garden markets. Its customer base includes snack food producers, pet nutrition brands, and health product companies, with testimonials highlighting partnership-oriented service and quick turnaround.

The company differentiates itself through a sustainability-first approach, emphasizing recyclable materials, waste reduction, and energy conservation. It earned the Best Packaging Supplier 2020 award from the Pet Sustainability Coalition for its holistic green design. Morris Packaging also promotes its leading-edge graphics and printing technology as a way to give brands shelf presence, positioning itself as a partner rather than just a supplier.
